text: Quick plan check: the pretraining run needs roughly 12,000 A100-hours and it has to be done in 4 weeks for the workshop deadline. We checkpoint every hour. Finance gave us $30k for compute. Lambda quoted $1.90 on demand; reserved for a year was $1.50.
